frames.title: Stand watch
frames.description: Front-right, standing watch with feet braced, holding a short wooden-shafted spear upright and a small round worn iron-rimmed shield resting by left leg. Helmet and brigandine unchanged.

frames.title: Guard ready
frames.description: Front-left, alert guard stance, shield raised across torso and spear angled low forward. Full spear within cell; no attack or victim.

frames.title: Patrol
frames.description: Right-side, patrolling at a measured step with spear upright and shield slung close to arm.

frames.title: Inspect hammer
frames.description: Front-right, seated on a simple stool at low tool bench inspecting a small worn hammer head and handle for damage.

frames.title: Sharpen utility knife
frames.description: Front-left, seated at same bench carefully sharpening a small utility knife on a flat whetstone, hands away from edge.

frames.title: Repair shield strap
frames.description: Front-right, seated at same bench repairing a leather strap or buckle on shield with awl, small tools laid out neatly.

note: Character and work props are composed together. These six scenes are independent static references, not an animation loop.
